name: White with titles (25 years)
description: An all-white A330-300 freighter with only titles: 'MNG' in heavy dark grey and 'AIRLINES' in thin blue capitals above the wing's leading edge, and ahead of them '25years' in a large light-blue handwritten script (MNG's 25th year, 2022). A small Turkish flag behind the forward door. White fin with no mark, white engines.

sources.title: TC-MCM JFK Landing 4R MB A330 343 F 25 Years Small (CC BY-SA 2.0, Mark Bess)
sources.note: TC-MCM on approach at JFK, right side from below, 2022-12-10. Fitted (flipped nose-left) to shapes/A333.json, loosely (within 33 px: three-quarter from below): the titles' and script's ends along the fuselage. Their heights are taken from MNB/standard's, which the photo agrees with.

sources.title: TC-MCM (13 Jan 2024) (CC0, Dltl2010)
sources.note: Right side climbing out at Hong Kong, 2024-01-13: the same, still all white, '25years' still on.

sources.title: MNG Airlines Airbus A330-343P2F TC-MCM (CC BY-SA 4.0, Liuboyoupeter)
sources.note: From below, 2022-07-05: plain white fin and belly; not measured (the photo carries a watermark).

titles.style: 'MNG' in heavy geometric capitals, dark grey.
'AIRLINES' in thin blue capitals straight after.
On the right, 'AIRLINES' forward, after 'MNG' read from the tail.
On the right, 'MNG' aft, partly behind the wing root from the front.
A large flowing handwritten script in light blue, the 2 and 5 tall and joined, 'years' running on from the 5 and rising slightly, ahead of the titles across the main deck.

logos.description: Small Turkish flag behind the forward door.

notes: TC-MCM came to MNG as a converted A330-300 freighter (P2F) and has flown all white with titles since at least July 2022 (2022 and January 2024 photos, both from the right). Its titles run x 0.311-0.493 (AIRLINES forward on the right; on the left, not seen in an open photo, MNG is put forward, as on the standard), further forward than on TC-MCZ's A330-200, and the script x 0.148-0.276. The fit is loose (three-quarter from below), so heights come from MNB/standard. Whether the '25years' script has since been taken off isn't known from open photos (the latest is January 2024). Kept as its own scheme rather than a special: it's the aircraft's everyday paint, not an occasion's wrap.
